title: Credit Builder Accounts: The Amount a Goodwill Credit Is Figured On After Recent Returns
content:
A goodwill credit on a Credit Builder late fee is figured on an amount that depends on recent returned payments on the account and on how the late fee's installment was presented. The goodwill share is applied to the amount set below.

## Base of the credit

- When a payment on the account was returned less than one whole calendar month before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month one month earlier falls outside), the credit is figured on the account's unpaid fees, that is the late fee together with every other fee still unpaid.
- When no payment was returned in that month but an AutoPay debit (a payment made through the AutoPay channel) was posted toward the due date the late fee is for, the credit is figured on the late fee plus every returned-payment fee charged in the 3 whole calendar months before today (a fee dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 3 months earlier falls outside them).
- Otherwise the credit is figured on the late fee.

The late fee is the account's most recent late fee; the due date it is for is the installment due date on its late-fee entry. The account's unpaid fees are the unpaid-fee balance the account record shows. The returned-payment fees counted are the account's returned-payment fee entries by their dates, whether or not they have since been paid.

| Return on the account within the 1 month | AutoPay payment posted toward the late fee's due date | Amount the credit is figured on |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the account's unpaid fees |
| no | yes | the late fee plus the returned-payment fees of the 3 months |
| no | no | the late fee |

## Cases (hypothetical fees)

Late fee 8.00; the account's unpaid fees are 18.00, made up of that late fee and a returned-payment fee of 10.00 charged 50 days ago, the only returned-payment fee in the 3 months.

| Account | Amount figured on |
|---|---|
| a payment returned 12 days ago | the unpaid fees, 18.00 |
| no return in the month; the installment for the late fee's due date was presented by AutoPay | 8.00 plus 10.00, that is 18.00 |
| no return in the month; that installment was paid by debit card | 8.00 |
